summary: BP PLC filed a Form 6-K announcing the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting (AGM). The filing reports poll results on 24 resolutions, including director elections, reappointment of auditor, executive compensation, share allotment authority, share buyback authorization, and several special resolutions concerning articles of association and a shareholder proposal. All ordinary resolutions passed with substantial support, while resolutions 22 and 23 on articles of association failed to achieve majority. The filing is a routine AGM outcome report; no special-situation event such as acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, or management changes is presented. This is a standard foreign issuer current report of shareholder votes.
